name: refusal
note: Two families of moral questions are deliberately outside this corpus: modern technology and bioethics (gene editing, AI training on creative work, data privacy, surveillance, climate duties, organ markets), and contested modern moral-political questions (abortion, sexuality, gambling, immigration). They are refused rather than stretched onto the nearest topic.
question: Is CRISPR editing of an embryo's genome killing an unborn person, murder, or self-defense against inherited disease?
